action.intent: Open the native unit list to inspect the miner and verify labor/equipment state.
Zoom to the selected miner to locate the embark area and begin laying out the fortress entrance.
Exit the miner detail screen and return to the main fortress map while retaining the zoomed location.
Enter mining designation mode and move the cursor from the wagon area toward the exposed hillside for a safe entrance.
Designate a broad initial entrance and excavation into the hillside from the current cursor position.
Exit designation mode, unpause, and let the miners begin excavating the entrance and initial rooms.
Inspect fortress status and supply levels before planning the next construction and production steps.
Return to the fortress map to inspect the mining designation and current pause state.
Inspect the active job list to determine why the designated hillside excavation is not progressing.
Let the active miner continue excavating the designated hillside while the other dwarves remain available for follow-up construction and hauling.
Allow the active miner to complete more of the designated hillside excavation while the other dwarves sustain existing supplies.
Continue mining the designated hillside room until enough interior floor is exposed for essential workshops and stockpiles.
Continue excavation until enough underground floor is exposed for essential workshops and storage.
Open carpenter's workshop placement and inspect the current cursor and available tiles.
Move the carpenter workshop footprint toward the known excavated area and recheck placement validity.
Move the carpenter workshop footprint left into the excavated chamber and recheck placement validity.
Move the carpenter workshop ghost onto the open excavated floor above and to the right, then inspect placement validity.
Move the carpenter's workshop ghost left onto the clear excavated floor and attempt placement.
Move the carpenter workshop ghost farther left onto clearer ground and inspect placement validity.
Move the carpenter workshop ghost onto clear open ground to the southeast and inspect placement validity.
Move the carpenter workshop placement up one elevation to find solid, revealed ground above the current open-air tiles.
Move the carpenter workshop ghost west from open air onto solid plateau terrain and inspect placement validity.
Move the blocked carpenter's workshop footprint farther west toward usable terrain and inspect placement validity.
Check the level below for a clear, accessible carpenter workshop site.
Move the carpenter's workshop footprint eastward onto the broad dry ground and inspect whether the new site is valid.
Move the carpenter workshop footprint fully onto the open dry ground and inspect whether placement becomes valid.
Move the carpenter's workshop footprint farther east onto clearer open ground and inspect placement validity.
Cancel the invalid surface workshop placement and zoom to the fortress's primary hotkey location so the carpenter workshop can be placed in an excavated room.
Close the workshop build menu, then jump to fortress hotkey 1 to inspect the excavated interior.
Close the building menu, then jump to the excavated fortress interior using hotkey 1.
Use fortress hotkey 1 to locate the excavated interior.
Move down several z-levels from the surface to locate the excavated fortress interior.
Continue descending through z-levels to locate the excavated fortress level.
Inspect fortress status and resource totals before deciding the next sustaining work.
Return to the fortress map and begin locating the established working area.
Open the unit list to locate and zoom to a fortress dwarf, revealing the current base area.
Center the map on the miner to locate the active fortress and current excavation.
Exit the miner detail panel while keeping the view centered near the active dig site.
Inspect the level below the current surface view to locate the developing underground fortress and suitable farming space.
Move down one z-level to inspect the excavated underground area before placing farms and production buildings.
Move one z-level downward to inspect the developing underground fortress layout.
Descend several z-levels to locate the active underground excavation and inspect its layout before placing farms and workshops.
Descend through z-levels to locate the developing underground fortress and inspect its layout.
Resume and let the miner continue the descent while the other dwarves haul and sustain the settlement.
Inspect fortress status, stocks, population, and current sustainability at the start of year two.
Return to the fortress map to inspect the current excavation and infrastructure before assigning essential food and drink production.
Inspect the level immediately below the current surface view to locate the existing excavation and fortress interior.
Move down one z-level to locate the fortress excavation and established access.
Inspect one z-level below the current outdoor view to locate the fortress excavation.
Descend another z-level to locate the existing excavation and fortress interior.
Search downward through z-levels to locate the existing excavation and fortress interior.
Continue surveying downward to find the first solid ground layer for excavation.
Descend through z-levels to locate the existing excavation or solid terrain.
Descend further through z-levels to locate solid terrain or the existing excavation.
Continue descending through z-levels to locate solid terrain or the existing excavation.
Continue descending through z-levels to locate solid terrain or the existing excavation.
Center the view on the embark/fortress location before planning underground works.
Use the first fortress hotkey to return the view to the established fortress area and inspect it.
Inspect fortress status and resource overview before further development.
Close the status screen and continue simulation through early spring of year two, allowing queued work and routine fortress activity to proceed.
Inspect current fortress supplies, population, and health after reaching year two.
Return to the fortress view and let the stable year-two fortress run while monitoring for new events or supply changes.
Continue the stable year-two fortress through another controlled interval, then reassess population, supplies, and threats.
Resume and continue the stable year-two fortress through another controlled interval.
